IconSetProvider.use: bind an icon set for a subtree

size.sm: inline with dense text or a sm control

rules.name: A stable role from the linked set (e.g. "close", "chevron-down"), portable across a set swap. Use this, not data, unless the geometry is project-specific.
rules.label: Omit when the icon sits inside a control that already has an accessible name (a labelled Button, text beside it): the icon stays decorative (aria-hidden). Set label only when the icon stands alone and means something by itself — that makes it content (role="img").
rules.IconSetProvider: Default set is Phosphor; wrap a subtree in IconSetProvider to bind lucide or material instead. Only the set actually imported ships in the bundle.
rules.data: Use the data prop instead of name for project-specific geometry that isn't part of the portable stable vocabulary; data and name are mutually exclusive.
